bio: If you're looking for a peaceful afternoon, dining on a scrumptious Afternoon Tea, then head to Nunsmere Hall in Delamere Forest, Cheshire.  Set against a backdrop of picturesque Cheshire countryside and surrounded by a 60-acre lake in the heart of Delamere Forest, Nunsmere Hall offers an idyllic setting to enjoy an Afternoon Tea. Blending historic charm and timeless elegance, you can enjoy this quintessentially British treat in true style. Savour a selection of delicate finger sandwiches, warm scones with clotted cream and jam as well as an irresistible selection of cakes.
